Compression/blur re-confirmed absent on all 5 pairs: block_boundary 0.9951-1.0034, unique_G 256, spectral_slope_ratio 0.966-1.000.

candidate_ranking.decision: REJECT for CHANGE (1/5 WEAK->PARTIAL, not majority)

analysis.rationale: R1 signal reinterpretation identified a real gap in R0's severity grid (sat3 never tested jointly with noise). Candidate B (nY1+sat3) improved signal-level fit on 4/5 pairs (sigma matches 4/5 vs 2/5; variance matches 3/5 vs 2/5; mean diffs halved on pairs 2/3) but only pair0 transitioned WEAK->PARTIAL and pair4 transitioned PARTIAL->WEAK, so the mandated majority-pair WEAK->PARTIAL/MATCH criterion for noise-containing candidates is not met. The residual mismatch is structural: the YCrCb-saturation model darkens every pair by ~-9..-18 while the target darkens only -2..-3 on the two vivid pairs, and no integer saturation severity bridges that gap. Per protocol: no majority evidence -> NO_CHANGE; R0 pipeline retained, candidate B recorded as alternative.
